name: Arroway
description: Arroway is shared memory for teams and the AI assistants that work with them. People curate the rules, decisions, facts, and references their team wants assistants to use. Assistants can read a project’s standing norms before proposing a course of action, review recent dated context, and append a concise record of work. Changes to human-approved content are proposed for review rather than applied as edits, so people keep the final say.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Arroway to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Arroway to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.arroway.app/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Arroway MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Arroway lists 16 MCP tools, including arroway_catch_up, arroway_claim, arroway_close, arroway_complete_read, arroway_continue, arroway_log, arroway_move, arroway_norms, arroway_pass, arroway_read, arroway_remember, and arroway_retire.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Arroway?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Arroway in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Arroway requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Arroway is developed by Arroway. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
